seo.title: Play Sweet Bomb or a Wild, a 6x5 Candy Cascade Slot Demo
seo.description: Play the browser demo of Sweet Bomb or a Wild, a 6x5 candy cascade slot: bomb multipliers, 96.00% published RTP, 12,777x max win. Play money, nothing to buy.
seo.imageAlt: The Sweet Bomb or a Wild board, a 6x5 grid of candy and fruit symbols over a candy landscape, above the demo's play-money credit meter.

notes: The balance is play money. It lives in this browser, it has no value, and it cannot be cashed out, transferred, or topped up with anything real.
Nothing is for sale. There is no payment step anywhere in this page, and no account to create.
Outcomes are generated live, in this page. Every round is drawn by the game's own maths engine running in your browser. Nothing is pre-recorded, and the page needs no connection to a server to play.

The demo's own return is not the published figure. The published build ships a weighted outcome table solved to land on 96.00%. This demo draws from the engine directly, without that weighting, so what it pays over the long run will not match that number exactly in either direction.
A short session proves nothing. A published return is an average over millions of rounds. A few hundred spins will land nowhere near it, in either direction, and that is true of real play too.
footnote: Both figures above are read from the game's own math configuration (PUBLISHED_RTP and MAX_WIN_MULTIPLIER), not estimated. The starting balance applies to a first visit: this browser remembers where you left off.
